summary: End-to-end tested the new Configuration Borne (Kiosk config) module — backend + frontend. 11/12 backend tests pass; the 1 failure is due to an EXPIRED Stripe live secret key (env), not a code defect, though link-reader/register-reader error handling should still catch AuthenticationError and return a friendlier 500/502 with a clear message. All frontend UI flows pass: admin login → Gestion Hotels → three-dots menu → Configuration Borne opens (kiosk-config visible), Destinations tab shows 6 rows, reorder / highlight / hide toggles work and 'Enregistrer les destinations' saves (toast success), Bornes tab: adding a borne creates device-card-TERM-001 (label, 'Jamais connectée' badge, Reader ID/Location ID '—', borne link /kiosk/bristol?device=TERM-001) and the page stays on the Bornes tab (no full-page spinner / tab reset regression). Reader dialogs (register + link modes) open with correct fields (reader-code, reader-address, reader-city, reader-postal, link-reader-id) and are editable. Delete borne removes the card. Paramètres tab default-language-select shows 'Français' and switches to English persistently (PUT succeeds); restored to Français. Mobile 390x844 layout renders. Bristol was restored to original state (6 destinations, none hidden/highlighted, in original order; no leftover TEST_ devices; default_language=fr).

critical.issue: Stripe live secret key is EXPIRED — reader Register/Link/reader-status will always fail in this environment. Confirmed via backend logs: `stripe._error.AuthenticationError: Expired API Key provided: sk_live_Q7******************P5HA`. This blocks real Stripe Terminal reader onboarding entirely.

When Stripe.Reader.retrieve raises AuthenticationError (or any non-InvalidRequest error), endpoint returns 500 with the raw traceback path. Should catch stripe.error.AuthenticationError and return 500 with a French message like 'Cle API Stripe expiree — contactez l'administrateur'. Also non-InvalidRequest errors from Reader.retrieve should be caught (currently only InvalidRequestError is handled → falls through to 500).

issues: React hydration console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. Comes from a wrapper span with style={display:'contents'} injected between <tbody> and <tr>. Not visible to users but pollutes console and is a hydration warning. Not blocking testing.

action_items: Rotate/replace STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET_KEY in backend/.env — current one is expired (Stripe rejected with AuthenticationError). Until this is fixed no Stripe Terminal reader can be attached from back-office in this environment.

In /app/backend/routes/kiosk_admin.py device_link_reader / device_register_reader: broaden except to also handle stripe.error.AuthenticationError, stripe.error.APIConnectionError, stripe.error.StripeError and surface a clean 502 with French message (currently returns bare 500).
Optional: fix hydration warning in HotelsManager (remove display:contents span wrapping <tr> inside <tbody>).
critical_code_review_comments: kiosk_admin.py device_register_reader: `except stripe.error.InvalidRequestError` is fine, but the generic `except Exception` below correctly catches auth errors as 502 — however for link-reader the fallthrough path re-raises as 500. Unify error handling across both endpoints.

kiosk.py /heartbeat matches by device id OR device_code — good for scalable multi-borne. Consider returning 404 when no match found instead of 200 {ok:false} so borne clients can detect stale device_id.
kiosk_admin.py _clean_device mutates the input dict — fine here but avoid returning the same reference to caller in bulk operations to prevent subtle bugs.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing kiosk_hotels.bristol. All state restored after tests (6 destinations, order preserved, none hidden/highlighted; no TEST_ devices; default_language=fr).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Only real gap is the expired Stripe live secret — reader register/link will 500 until the key is rotated. Backend regression test file is /app/backend/tests/test_kiosk_admin_config.py (pytest, 12 tests). To avoid touching Stripe on future runs, keep test_link_reader_invalid_id lenient (accepts 404 OR 500).
rca of the issue: Backend log shows `stripe._error.AuthenticationError: Expired API Key provided: sk_live_Q7******************P5HA` on POST /api/admin/kiosk/devices/{id}/link-reader. The route only catches InvalidRequestError, so AuthenticationError propagates as 500. Root cause: STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET_KEY expired. Mitigation: (1) rotate the Stripe live key in backend/.env and restart backend; (2) widen the except block to include stripe.error.AuthenticationError → return HTTPException(502, 'Stripe indisponible — cle API invalide').
